job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Vector Search - Elasticsearch
job.pay_full: $133,100 – $210,600 a year typical starting base salary; $159,900 – $252,900 a year in select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City Metro Area)

details.about: Elastic, the Search AI Company, makes the Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than half of the Fortune 500 for search, security and observability. This role joins the Elasticsearch Search Relevance team, a globally distributed group of expert engineers focused on a robust, feature-rich search experience, including improvements to Lucene. Elastic is distributed by intention: it hires engineers wherever they are and collaborates daily over email, GitHub, Zoom and Slack.
duties: Lead initiatives that make Elasticsearch an industry-leading search engine for speed and relevance
Contribute to Elasticsearch full time: build new search features, fix bugs and make the code easier to understand
Invent or find and implement new algorithms and data structures, sometimes working close to the operating system and hardware
Work with a globally distributed team focused on Elasticsearch's vector search capabilities
Be an expert on Elasticsearch search relevance and drive improvements
Work with community members worldwide on issues and pull requests
Write idiomatic modern Java (Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java)
needs: Implemented novel vector-similarity techniques on a search platform with a large user base, or advanced academic research in vector-similarity information retrieval
Professional experience with search or vector databases, using HNSW, IVF or other relevant algorithms and libraries at scale
Solid core Java skills, including standard data structures, concurrency constructs and lambdas
Ability to work with high autonomy and guide projects from technical design to delivery
Comfort giving and receiving feedback on code, approaches and APIs
Experience with data storage technologies such as Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Cassandra
A proven track record of using AI tools to speed up development, debugging and code optimization while owning the outcome
Ability to collaborate across functions and move between projects, codebases or teams
Driving decisions in a distributed team through asynchronous, direct and transparent communication
nice: Open-source experience, with different source-control workflows and continuous integration
Experience designing, leading and owning cross-functional initiatives
details.benefits: Typical starting base salary $133,100 – $210,600 a year; in select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA and the New York City Metro Area) $159,900 – $252,900 a year. Pay is base salary only, with no variable component. The role is currently eligible for Elastic's stock program. Benefits include a company-matched 401(k) (dollar for dollar up to 6% of eligible earnings), health coverage for you and your family in many locations, flexible locations and schedules for many roles, generous vacation, donation matching up to $2,000, up to 40 hours a year of volunteer time and at least 16 weeks of parental leave.
notes: Elastic is a distributed company that hires engineers wherever they are
Accommodations during the application process can be requested by email at candidate_accessibility@elastic.co
The role is subject to U.S. export-control requirements for people located in or nationals of certain sanctioned countries and regions
